title: 12. The firſt death cannot be eternal.

segments.text:
THis death cānot be eternall, for by that meanes the bodye at the leaſt had eſcaped ye eternal death which bringeth wyth it ſorowe and perpetuall puniſhement: and likewiſe it ſhould neuer haue enioyned the eternall felicitie: and ſo by this meanes the eternall coū
ſell of god concerning the declaratiō of his mercy & iuſtice ſhuld be made voide.
